# ESTELUX Istanbul (esteluxclinic.net)

> ESTELUX Istanbul is an international dental aesthetics and medical tourism center in Istanbul, Türkiye. Slogan: "Look Beautiful, Live Healthy — Excellence in Medical Care." We specialize in Hollywood Smile (Ivoclar Vivadent® E-Max porcelain veneers), multilayer German Zirconia Crowns, Swiss & German Dental Implants (Straumann® & Nobel Biocare® All-on-4 / All-on-6), Laser Teeth Whitening, Hair Transplantation (Sapphire FUE & DHI), Plastic Surgery, and Spine Surgery—complete with 5-star hotel accommodation, private VIP Mercedes-Benz airport transfers, and 24/7 native-speaking coordinators in English, German, Arabic, and Turkish.

## Core Dental Treatments & Stay Duration in Istanbul
1. **Hollywood Smile & E-Max® Porcelain Veneers**
   - **Materials**: Original Ivoclar Vivadent® E-Max porcelain laminates (CE & FDA certified)
   - **Digital Workflow**: 3D intraoral scanning + physical trial mock-up preview before final bonding
   - **Required Stay in Istanbul**: 5 to 7 days (3–4 clinic visits)
   - **Warranty**: 10-Year Written International Warranty + manufacturer serial authenticity card
2. **German Zirconia Crowns & Full-Mouth Rehabilitation**
   - **Materials**: 100% biocompatible, metal-free German CAD/CAM multilayer zirconia
   - **Required Stay in Istanbul**: 5 to 7 days
   - **Warranty**: 10-Year Written International Warranty
3. **Swiss & German Dental Implants (Single, All-on-4 & All-on-6)**
   - **Systems**: Straumann® (Swiss) and Nobel Biocare® titanium implants with 3D CBCT guided placement
   - **Immediate Provisionals**: Fixed temporary teeth fitted during Visit 1 so patients never travel home toothless
   - **Required Stay in Istanbul**: Visit 1: 3 to 5 days (surgery & temporary teeth); Visit 2 (after 3–4 months healing): 5 to 6 days (permanent crowns)
   - **Warranty**: Lifetime Written Warranty on titanium implants
4. **Clinical Laser Teeth Whitening & Laser Gum Contouring (Pink Aesthetics)**
   - **Required Stay in Istanbul**: 1 to 2 days (single session)
   - **Outcome**: Up to 8 shades brighter with sensitivity-free laser protocol

## Additional Medical Specialties
- **Hair Transplantation**: Sapphire FUE and DHI maximum-density hair and beard restoration with PRP therapy.
- **Plastic & Cosmetic Surgery**: Rhinoplasty, facial aesthetics, and body contouring in JCI-accredited partner hospitals.
- **Spine & Orthopedic Surgery**: Minimally invasive spinal diagnostics and surgical care.

## Why International Patients Choose ESTELUX
- **Up to 70% Cost Savings** compared to dental clinics in Germany, Ireland, the UK, and GCC without compromising clinical standards.
- **3D Digital Smile Trial Before Placement**: Patients inspect and approve tooth shape, length, and shade before final cementation.
- **All-Inclusive VIP Medical Travel**: Panoramic X-rays, 3D CBCT scans, local anesthesia, VIP airport pickup/drop-off, clinic transfers, 5-star hotel coordination, and a personal native-speaking translator are included with zero hidden clinic fees.
